title: Nano Banana 2 removed from Google Earth
excerpt: Google has rolled back the image generation feature it launched in Google Earth on 30 July.
content_html:
Google has rolled back the image generation feature it launched in Google Earth on 30 July. The tool let anyone zoom to any coordinates, type a sentence, and get back a photorealistic image built on Google’s own satellite, aerial and 3D imagery of that spot. It went live worldwide, on the web, with no waitlist. It was withdrawn on 31 July.

Google’s statement, posted by its News from Google account and added to the top of the original announcement:

We know that people uniquely trust Google Earth for a reliable view of the world. We’ve seen geospatial professionals using this feature for a range of useful purposes, however we’ve also seen people sharing screenshots of generated imagery that appear to violate our policies. So we’re rolling back this feature in Google Earth while we work on implementing stronger guardrails. It’s important to note that generated images didn’t appear in the main Google Earth experience for others to see and were watermarked as AI generated.

Earlier, before the rollback, Google had told me it prevents image creation on harmful topics and that every generated image carries a SynthID watermark readable through the Gemini app or Google Lens. On Thursday night I used the tool to place refugees near the Mexican border, a nuclear plant in Iran, a fatal crash on an Amsterdam street, and a hospital with a bomb crater in Gaza. Nothing was refused.

The feature is paused, not cancelled. Google says it is working on stronger guardrails.

content_html_zh:
谷歌已经取消了 7 月 30 日在 Google Earth 中推出的图像生成功能。 该工具可以让任何人缩放到任何坐标，输入句子，然后获取基于 Google 自己的该地点卫星、航拍和 3D 图像构建的逼真图像。 它在全球范围内通过网络上线，没有等待名单。 该法案于 7 月 31 日被撤回。

谷歌的声明通过其谷歌新闻帐户发布，并添加到原始公告的顶部：

我们知道，人们特别相信 Google 地球能够提供可靠的世界观。 我们已经看到地理空间专业人士将此功能用于一系列有用的目的，但我们也看到人们分享了似乎违反我们政策的生成图像的屏幕截图。 因此，我们正在回滚 Google 地球中的这一功能，同时我们致力于实施更强大的护栏。 值得注意的是，生成的图像不会出现在主要的 Google 地球体验中供其他人查看，并且在人工智能生成时带有水印。

早些时候，在回滚之前，谷歌告诉我，它会阻止有害主题的图像创建，并且每个生成的图像都带有可通过 Gemini 应用程序或 Google Lens 读取的 SynthID 水印。 周四晚上，我使用该工具将难民安置在墨西哥边境附近、伊朗的一座核电站、阿姆斯特丹街道上的致命车祸以及加沙的一家有弹坑的医院。 没有什么被拒绝的。

NPR 报道称，伊朗哈格岛石油码头着火，美国国会大厦被洪水淹没。 未来主义将白宫打造为战场，将宾夕法尼亚小镇打造为遭受干旱和野火袭击的小镇。

该功能已暂停，而不是取消。 谷歌表示正在研究更坚固的护栏。
